Folio — the curated theme set

Home regenerated per theme from the six swatches each face authors. Nine families × two separately painted faces = eighteen faces, no two of which share a palette. The masthead is now drawn as well — its status band and its wordmark, the latter wearing the theme's fitted accent (accentProgress), which is the change the last two sections explain.
